text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Some time had passed since Shinko Windy and I sprinted through our first three years together, when one day...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Lackeyyyyyy!!
It's bad, it's terrible, this is an emergencyyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I heard some super amazing info, noda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Word is that right now, the entire cafeteria menu is 99% off!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's true~!
The carrot hamburg set meal is super cheap too!
Even if you add pudding or cake, it's still dirt cheap!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
However...
it appears it is only available to the first 10 customers.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you don't hurry, they'll all be gone!
Come on, wrap up your work and let's go~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since it happened to be lunchtime, we headed to the cafeteria together. However, when we asked the staff...

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Clerk
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? We're not having a sale like that though...?
99% off... that can't be... *giggle*!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Upupu... Heeheeheehee...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-nyah-nyah-nyaaah!!
You totally fell for it~~~~~!!!
choice_data_list: Geez... I knew this would happen.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Too baaaad for you!!
You'll just have to eat at the regular price!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, since we're here,
Windy-chan is gonna eat too, nano da!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I wouldn't mind sharing a table with you, you know.
After all, watching your glum face while I eat
isn't half bad!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy declared with a smug look.
Could this be... No, it definitely is.
choice_data_list: Did you want to have lunch together?
Did you want to have lunch together?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?!
There's no way that's true!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to see the disappointed look on your faaaace, that's aaaaall!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I had also been wanting to discuss her upcoming races, so the timing was perfect. When I told her that, her smug expression returned.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oho, is that so, is that so! That's quite admirable.
You are my wicked chief of staff, after all.
choice_data_list: Let's give it our all in the next race, too.
Let's do our best in the next race, too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heheheh, of course I did!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've still gotta make Windy-chan's
"notorious" name echo throughout the racing world, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, go get the food quick!
It's time to start the strategy meeting~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, the two had a delicious lunch together, chatting about races and training.
